title: twinery://story/current/twee
description: Full Twee 3 source for the active story, emitted via extwee. Use when the LLM needs to see the exact canonical source (e.g., for quoting in explanations). Byte-identical to what save_story would write.

properties.body_description: UTF-8 Twee 3 source. Begins with :: StoryTitle, :: StoryData, and then one header-and-text block per passage.
